title: Practice 2: Instrumental endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Tom admired the pearly whiteness of the fabric.
exercises.why: Feminine nouns ending in **ь** have **-ью** in the instrumental. *площадь --> площадью лошадь --> лошадью церковь --> церковью* — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.
exercises.context: Feminine nouns ending in **ь** have **-ью** in the instrumental.

exercises.prompt: Cyber activists want to meet with the Supreme Leader.
exercises.why: Adjectives modifying masculine or neuter nouns in the instrumental case have two endings: adjectives which have the default ending **ый** or **ое** have the instrumental ending **ым**, and those which end in **ий** or **ее** have **им**. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.
exercises.context: Adjectives modifying masculine or neuter nouns in the instrumental case have two endings: adjectives which have the default ending **ый** or **ое** have the instrumental ending **ым**, and those which end in **ий** or **ее** have **им**.
